purpose: Add three independently trained real-label pragmatics readouts before the K=16 one-forward scaling benchmark; this expansion does not alter EXP001 tasks or results.

dataset.exact_duplicate_policy: remove all exact-text label-conflict groups, then retain test before validation before train for remaining duplicates

candidate_family.window_operation: standardize each hidden output on the fit split, then mean adjacent standardized outputs

baseline: class-weighted word 1-2 plus character 2-5 TF-IDF logistic on identical fit rows

uncertainty.limitation: The released files omit author and article/thread IDs, so paired uncertainty is row-level and cannot support an unseen-author or unseen-article claim.

expected_then_check.expected: The three related pragmatics targets will be detectable above prevalence, but the best pooling and normalized depth may differ by target and TF-IDF may remain stronger for lexical targets.
expected_then_check.check: Report all 216 validation candidates per target, one-shot official-test metrics, calibration, and paired activation-minus-TF-IDF intervals.

research_scope: Internal non-commercial research benchmark. Public redistribution remains a separate project-owner decision under the source licence.
